tool.name: upgrade_helm_chart
tool.description: Upgrade an existing Helm chart release

name.description: Name of the Helm release to upgrade

chart.description: Chart name or path to chart directory

context.description: Kubeconfig Context to use for the command (optional - defaults to null)

repo.description: Helm repository URL (optional if using local chart path)

values.description: Custom values to override chart defaults

valuesFile.description: Path to values file (alternative to values object). The path is read on the machine running the MCP server, so it is rejected when the server runs over a remote (SSE/Streamable HTTP) transport; use 'values' to pass the values inline instead.
